sections.name: Sub-Criterion A.1 Amount of Desalinated Water Supply Made Available
sections.quote: Sub-Criterion A.1 Amount of Desalinated Water Supply Made Available Points will be awarded based on the expected amount of desalinated water made available.

sections.name: Sub-Criterion A.2 Offset to Water Supplies
sections.quote: Sub-Criterion A.2 Offset to Water Supplies Points will be awarded based on the extent to which the project will reduce demands on existing water supply sources

sections.name: Criterion B: Water Management Concerns and Project Benefits
sections.quote: Describe the water management challenge(s) occurring within your project area and the severity of the challenge to be addressed.

sections.name: Subcriterion C.1 Cost Effectiveness Analysis
sections.quote: Points will be awarded based on the cost per acre-foot of water expected to be delivered upon completion of the project and how the cost of the project compares to a non-desalination alternative.

sections.name: Subcriterion C.2 Benefit/Cost Analysis
sections.quote: Summarize the economic analysis performed for the project including information on the project's estimated benefits and costs.

sections.name: Criterion D: Presidential and Department of the Interior Priorities
sections.quote: Up to 20 points may be awarded based on the extent that the project demonstrably: advances the Trump Administration's priorities,

sections.name: Subcriterion E.1 Collaborative Regional Planning
sections.quote: Points will be awarded based on the extent to which the project implements a regional planning effort and meets the needs of different areas and stakeholders within the region.

sections.name: Subcriterion E.2 Leveraging State Funding and Experience of International Partners
sections.quote: Points will be awarded based on the extent to which the project leverages State funding for research and development of desalination technologies and projects and/or the experience of international partners

sections.name: Criterion F: Construction Priority
sections.quote: Please identify the hard infrastructure construction components of the project, if applicable.

sections.name: Criterion G: Cost Share Priority
sections.quote: State the percentage of non-Federal funding provided using the following calculation: Non-Federal Funding / Total Project Cost = %

eligibility.item: Eligible applicants: States, departments or subdivisions of a State, or public agencies organized under State law (e.g., Tribes, municipalities, irrigation districts, water districts, wastewater districts)
eligibility.quote: Applicants eligible to receive funding under this NOFO include States, departments of a State, subdivisions of a State, or public agencies organized pursuant to a State law, such as:

eligibility.item: Applicants must be located in Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Kansas, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Oregon, South Dakota, Texas, Utah, Washington, or Wyoming
eligibility.quote: All applicants must be located in one of the following States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Kansas, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Oregon, South Dakota, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming.

eligibility.item: Federal governmental entities, foreign entities, individuals, and institutes of higher education are not eligible
eligibility.quote: Ineligible Applicants - Those not eligible include, but are not limited to, the following entities: Federal Governmental entities Foreign entities Individuals Institutes of higher education

eligibility.item: Projects must be planning, design, and/or construction of facilities to desalinate seawater or brackish surface water or groundwater
eligibility.quote: Projects eligible for funding under this NOFO include planning, design, and/or construction of facilities to desalinate seawater or brackish surface water or groundwater.

eligibility.item: Project must be constructed, operated, and maintained by an eligible applicant, or sponsored by one that funds a substantial portion of capital construction costs within the NOFO timeframe
eligibility.quote: The project must be constructed, operated, and maintained by an eligible applicant; or the project must be sponsored by an eligible applicant.

eligibility.item: Project must have a completed feasibility study submitted to Reclamation by June 26, 2026 (first period) or January 15, 2027 (second period) and found to meet WTR 11-01 by November 20, 2026 or July 15, 2027
eligibility.quote: To be eligible for funding under this NOFO, the project must have a completed feasibility study submitted to Reclamation for review by June 26, 2026,

eligibility.item: Projects with total cost of $500 million or more must also meet WTR TRMR-128 feasibility study requirements
eligibility.quote: Applicants with desalination projects that have an estimated total project cost greater than or equal to $500 million (i.e., the minimum total project cost requirement for Large-Scale Water Recycling Projects) must meet additional feasibility study requirements

eligibility.item: Project must be in a state-approved plan (with documentation of state approval), or Federal participation must have been requested by the state's Governor, documented before the application deadline
eligibility.quote: The project must be included in a state-approved plan. The plan and documentation of state approval must be included with the proposal or submitted to Reclamation prior to the application deadline for this NOFO.

eligibility.item: Water recycling/reuse projects and desalination projects with water recycling components are not eligible
eligibility.quote: Projects that reclaim or reuse municipal, industrial, domestic, or agricultural wastewater.

eligibility.item: Projects whose feasibility study Reclamation found not to meet WTR 11-01 are not eligible
eligibility.quote: Projects that have a Reclamation reviewed feasibility study that Reclamation determined did not meet the requirements of WTR 11-01.

eligibility.item: Development of feasibility studies is not eligible for funding
eligibility.quote: Development of feasibility studies to meet the requirements Reclamation's Directives and Standards WTR 11-01 and/or WTR TRMR-128.

eligibility.item: Lab-scale research, piloting, or demonstration research on new advanced water treatment technology is not eligible
eligibility.quote: Lab-scale research, piloting, or demonstration research focused on the development and commercialization of new advanced water treatment technology,

eligibility.item: Projects with a project-specific congressional authorization are not eligible
eligibility.quote: Projects that have a project-specific congressional authorization.

eligibility.item: Projects that already received WaterSMART Drought Response Program funding are not eligible
eligibility.quote: Projects that have already received funding under the WaterSMART Drought Response Program.

eligibility.item: Normal operations, maintenance, and replacement (OM&R) projects are not eligible
eligibility.quote: Projects that are considered normal operations, maintenance, and replacement (OM&R) are not eligible for funding under this NOFO.

eligibility.item: Multiple applications are allowed if project scopes are not duplicative; closely related components should be combined in one application
eligibility.quote: Multiple applications for funding may be submitted for consideration under this funding opportunity, provided that the project scopes are not duplicative.

eligibility.item: Budgets may only include costs incurred after Reclamation's feasibility study review findings and within three years of the submission period deadline
eligibility.quote: budgets submitted under this NOFO may only include costs incurred after the date of Reclamation's feasibility determination, and within three years from the application deadline for each submission period under this NOFO.

eligibility.item: Buy America preferences apply: iron, steel, manufactured products and construction materials must be produced in the U.S.
eligibility.quote: Buy America preferences apply to Federal awards for infrastructure projects in the United States.

eligibility.item: Applicant must be registered in SAM.gov with a UEI and certify the Financial Assistance General Representations and Certifications before applying
eligibility.quote: Before applying, all applicants except individuals applying as a natural person must be registered in SAM.gov.

eligibility.item: Applicant must register with Grants.gov (allow 30 days), and an Authorized Organization Representative (AOR) must submit
eligibility.quote: Before applying, ensure that at least one person at your organization is registered and has the Authorized Organization Representative (AOR). Only the AOR can submit the

eligibility.item: By applying, the applicant certifies awareness of and compliance with all applicable executive orders and secretary's orders
eligibility.quote: By applying in response to this Notice of Funding Opportunity, the applicant certifies awareness and compliance with all currently effective and applicable executive orders and secretary's orders,

requiredDocuments.item: Title Page with project title, applicant name and address, and Project Manager contact details (Project Narrative)
requiredDocuments.quote: Title Page Provide a brief, informative, and descriptive title for the proposed work that indicates the nature of the project. Include the name and address of the applicant

requiredDocuments.item: Table of Contents listing all major sections of the proposal (Project Narrative)
requiredDocuments.quote: Table of Contents List all major sections of the proposal in the table of contents.

requiredDocuments.item: SF-424, Application for Federal Assistance (required from all applicants)
SF-424A, Budget Information, fully completed with Federal and non-Federal costs
requiredDocuments.quote: Reclamation uses the SF-424A for both construction and non-construction programs.

requiredDocuments.item: SF-LLL, Disclosure of Lobbying Activities (if requesting more than $100,000 and using non-Federal funds for lobbying)
Budget Narrative describing and justifying all costs, cost share, third-party contributions, pre-award costs, and the indirect cost approach
requiredDocuments.quote: Applicants must describe and justify items and costs listed in their budget. The budget narrative must identify the following cost items: total estimated costs, non-Federal cost share, third-party contributions, and any pre-award costs.

requiredDocuments.item: Copy of the most recently negotiated indirect cost rate agreement (if a rate was previously negotiated)
requiredDocuments.quote: If your organization has previously negotiated a rate, attach a copy of the most recently negotiated rate agreement (active or expired).

requiredDocuments.item: Letters of Support from interested stakeholders, attached at the end of the application
requiredDocuments.quote: Attach all support letters from interested stakeholders at the end of your application. Letters received after the application deadline will not be evaluated.

requiredDocuments.item: Overlap or Duplication of Effort Statement
requiredDocuments.quote: Applicants must state in their application if the activities, costs, or time commitment of key personnel proposed in this application overlap with those in any other Federal proposal or award or not.

requiredDocuments.item: Conflict of interest disclosure (if any actual or potential conflict exists)
requiredDocuments.quote: If any actual or potential conflict of interest exists related to this project at the time of application, the applicant must provide sufficient information

requiredDocuments.item: State-approved plan with documentation of state approval, or documentation of the Governor's request for Federal participation
requiredDocuments.quote: The applicant must submit documentation sufficient for Reclamation to make this determination along with their proposal prior to the application deadline.
